authority: Read-only prerequisite evidence preparation; no canonical/interface/research-definition choice.

obligations.O1: Bind exact local source bytes and quoted raw spans to registrant CIK, accession, primary-document URL, filing type and report period; accession prefix is not registrant CIK.
obligations.O2: Locate original cached SEC submission row and original filing-document response/cache/collection chain; reconcile filingDate/acceptanceDateTime to available_at/published_at/retrieved_at. Stored date fields or hashes alone are insufficient.
obligations.O3: Inspect local primary body for issuer/period/document anchors and possible later-version/update contamination. A 2026 retrieval alone does not invalidate an accession-bound historical filing; absence of archival retrieval proof is distinguished from affirmative contamination.
obligations.O4: Keep assessment date distinct from filing availability and case cutoff. No latest-present-truth, absence-of-weakness or equity-outcome inference.
obligations.O5: Pass only the claim directly supported by local material; unknown where an indispensable provenance link is absent. Include counterexamples to overclaiming and make no broad historical authenticity claim from self-consistent metadata.

decision_levels.pass_local_binding: Local original cache, accession/document/object and date relation substantiate the bounded historical filing-source claim. This is not independent remote attestation.
decision_levels.unknown: A required binding is absent/unsupported in bounded local material, or internal semantics conflict.
decision_levels.counterexample: Concrete evidence refutes a shortcut, positive conclusion, or inappropriate transfer.

stop: After checking exact source files, relevant SEC submission/document cache and original acquisition records for these four approved development cases. No broader data search or external acquisition.
